about: Landing page stills rendered from the city stage. Each poster has a 1600x1000 and an 800x500 file.

posters.alt: Vindhya Bhavan, a courtyard building on the IIIT Hyderabad campus, shown as a paper model among its real neighbours on a March morning.
The same campus just before sunset, with long shadows stretching east across the paper city.
Sun hours building up around the building during the day: ground that has had sun turns gold, shaded ground stays paper.
One floor slid out like a drawer, showing how far daylight reaches into each room from the windows.
Yearly sunlight falling on the walls and roof, from deep blue on shaded walls to gold on the open roof.
The campus at night: the modelled building glows like a lantern, brighter for more energy use, while unmodelled neighbours stay dark.
Three placements of the same building side by side: as drawn, turned a quarter, and on a plot further east.
